proof_body:
by
  intro f f' a b n hd hc
  have hne : ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hF : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b, HasDerivAt (fun x => f x ^ (n + 1) / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) (f x ^ n * f' x) x := by
    intro x hx
    refine (((hd x hx).fun_pow (n + 1)).div_const _).congr_deriv ?_
    simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    push_cast
    field_simp
  have hfc : ContinuousOn f (Set.uIcc a b) := fun x hx => (hd x hx).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  have hi : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => f x ^ n * f' x) MeasureTheory.volume a b :=
    ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable ((hfc.pow n).mul hc)
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hF hi]
  ring
target_source: ∀ (f f' : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (n : ℕ), (∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b, HasDerivAt f (f' x) x) → ContinuousOn f' (Set.uIcc a b) → (∫ x in a..b, f x ^ n * f' x) = (f b ^ (n + 1) - f a ^ (n + 1)) / ((n : ℝ) + 1)
